svg.title: careBT between the advisory layer and the skill layer
svg.desc: careBT forms the sequencing layer between an advisory layer (symbolic planners, AI agents, domain experts) and a skill layer (navigation, localization, perception, manipulation, robot base). Advisors receive goal and context and return plans, but have no direct robot control. careBT orchestrates and parameterizes the skills, receives progress and feedback, keeps a knowledge base, and adapts the behavior tree at runtime by inserting, replacing and removing nodes and by running contingency handlers.
